title:
Trade Your
Yoke
paragraphs: Jesus didn't walk up to tired people and tell them to try harder. He said come — not after you fix your life, not once you've finally got it together, but heavy laden, exactly as you are. That's the part we rush past: the invitation never waited for improvement. It met the exhaustion head-on and asked for the whole weight, unedited, right there in the middle of the collapse.

Then He does something nobody expects — He doesn't just lift the yoke off, He hands you a different one. His yoke, His pace, His portion. Rest, here, was never going to mean carrying nothing; it was always going to mean carrying the right thing, fitted to you, next to Him instead of alone. Trade is the whole gospel in one word: you hand over what's crushing you, and He hands you something that actually fits.
